description: Download a theme's files ({path: text}). theme_id "lokand-base" or "lokand-one" returns a system theme to start from. Custom themes return their latest stored version. A whole theme is large: pass search to find the lines you need to change, or list_only for paths and sizes, then paths for whole files.

list_only.description: Return only {path, size} for every file

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find, e.g. ".menu-item .name"; returns matching lines as {path, line, text} instead of files (combine with paths to limit where it looks)

theme_id.description: A theme id from theme_list (or a system theme id: lokand-base, lokand-one)

name: theme_pull
title: Theme pull
